transcript: I put the religious utopia at the bottom because I feel like there's a lot of different religions that exist now and if we put everyone on a faith-based order then no one would agree upon anything because everyone believes different things it would just kind of cause some chaos and then I put institutional utopia at the top because I feel like that's similar to the world we live in now. And I feel like people kind of need rules to guide them in their decisions and know the difference between right and wrong and that there are consequences if they disobey those laws.
